title: 第15章 岂容尔等惦记第16章 苏夫子
content_zh:
采花贼被砍了头，六十号牢房又空了出来。
因狱丞之争，天牢上上下下斗得越发厉害，狱卒们也被迫站队参与其中。
不站队想当骑墙派，只有死路一条。事关前程性命，骑墙派通常是最先死的那一撮人。
没有人能容忍一个骑墙派在身边活动。
只不过，还等不到收拾骑墙派，乙字号大牢率先出了事。
勋贵家的家奴死了。
家奴为主子顶罪，其实都是做表面文章，走个过场。等事情平息下去后，家奴就会放出去。
万万没想到，案子还没了结，人却死了。
这可是捅了马蜂窝，遮不住啊！
事情惊动了主事官，主事官终于舍得双眼往下面瞧一眼，得知天牢最近因为狱丞之争闹得乌烟瘴气，如今还闹出人命，大为震怒。
“狱丞之位，岂是尔等小小狱吏能惦记。”
一句话直接封死了所有人上进的路。
“既然不守本分，休怪本官无情！”
此话一出，就意味着必须死人。只能用死人的鲜血，方能给家奴背后的勋贵交代，方能让天牢上下一干人员，从狱吏到狱卒以及杂役们知道好歹。
纵然污秽如天牢，那也是官府的地盘，容不得一群卒子翻天。
管乙字号大牢的赵狱吏常年请假养病，平日里都是几个班头负责大小事情。
主事官杀鸡儆猴，将家奴死的那天当值的班头以及狱卒抓的抓，关的关，杀的杀，一个都没放过。
这一轮屠刀下来，天牢上下噤若寒蝉，谁都不敢替枉死的狱卒们喊一声冤，最多就是多包二两奠仪，聊表心意。
赵狱吏因为管理不当，虽然没被追责，却被夺了管理乙字号大牢的权柄，被罚去守库房。由张狱吏接替他的工作。
一时间，天牢上下秋风雅静，大家都守着规矩。

张万通也断了上进的路，显得格外颓废，整日睡大觉，半步不肯踏进大牢。大家敢怒不敢言，他是老资历，徒子徒孙不少，就连许富贵也只能找找茬，没办法将他开革。
之前，张万通想上进，许富贵找茬，他还挺难受。如今，他彻底摆烂，面对许富贵找茬，他是彻底不在意了。他也不怕被打小报告，就摆烂怎么着。
这个时候往上面告状，还是区区狱卒偷懒这等小事，上官只会认为许富贵无事生非，故意找麻烦，又没能力，一点都没眼色。没眼色的家伙都该统统滚蛋。
许富贵是有眼色的人，所以他见张万通彻底摆烂，也懒得管了。反正手低下那么多人，总有会来事的。
content_en:
The flower-picking thief was beheaded, and cell No. 60 was vacated again.
Due to the war between the prison chiefs, the fighting in the prison became more and more fierce, and the jailers were forced to join in the fight.
If you don't take sides and want to be a fence-sitter, you will only die. When it comes to the future and life, the fence-sitters are usually the first to die.
No one can tolerate a fence-sitting person around.
However, before the fence-sitting faction could be dealt with, something happened in Prison No. B first.
The slave of the Xungui family died.
Domestic slaves take the blame for their masters, but they are actually doing it superficially and just going through the motions. When things calm down, the slaves will be released.
Unexpectedly, the person died before the case was settled.
This is stirring up a hornet's nest, it can't be covered!
The incident alarmed the officer in charge, who was finally willing to look down and was furious when he learned that Tianlao had been in a turmoil recently due to the dispute between prison and prison officials, and now people were killed.
"How can you, a small jailer like you, care about the position of prison chief?"
One sentence directly blocked everyone's path to progress.
"Since you don't keep your duty, don't blame me for being ruthless!"
As soon as these words were spoken, it meant that someone had to die. Only the blood of the dead can be used to explain to the nobles behind the domestic slaves, and to let all the people in Tianlao, from the jailer to the jailers and the handymen, know what happened.
Even if it is as filthy as a prison, it is still the territory of the government and cannot tolerate a group of pawns.
Prisoner Zhao, who is in charge of Prison No. B, takes leave all year round to recuperate. On weekdays, several team leaders are responsible for all matters.
The officer in charge killed the chickens to scare the monkeys, arresting, imprisoning, and killing all the shift leaders and jailers who were on duty on the day the slave died.
This time the butcher's knife came down, the whole prison was completely silent. No one dared to cry out for the injustice of the jailers who died in vain. The most they could do was pay two taels more to pay homage to express their feelings.
Due to improper management, Prisoner Zhao was not held accountable, but he was deprived of the authority to manage the No. B cell and was punished to guard the warehouse. Jailer Zhang took over his job.
For a time, the autumn breeze was quiet in Tianlao, and everyone abided by the rules.
Zhang Wantong also lost his way to advancement and looked extremely decadent. He slept all day long and refused to step into the prison. Everyone dared to be angry but dared not speak out. He was a veteran and had many disciples and disciples. Even Xu Fugui could only find faults and had no way to fire him.
Before, Zhang Wantong wanted to make progress, but Xu Fugui found trouble, which made him feel quite uncomfortable. Now, he was completely ruined, and he didn't care at all when faced with Xu Fugui's troubles. He wasn't afraid of being reported, so he just showed it off.
At this time, if you complain to the superiors, even if it is a trivial matter like the jailer being lazy, the superior officer will only think that Xu Fugui is causing trouble for nothing, deliberately looking for trouble, and is incompetent and has no eyes at all. All those guys who don't have a look should get out.
Xu Fugui was a discerning person, so when he saw that Zhang Wantong was completely ruined, he didn't bother to care. Anyway, if there are so many people with low hands, something will happen.
